On a scale of 1–5, how would you rate your proficiency in SQL, including writing queries using joins and aggregations, working with stored procedures, optimizing query performance, and troubleshooting data issues?
options: 1 - Beginner – Limited SQL experience; can write basic queries with guidance.
2 - Basic – Can write simple SELECT statements and filter or sort data.
3 - Intermediate – Can independently write queries using joins, aggregations, and common functions to retrieve and analyze data.
4 - Advanced – Can write complex queries, work with stored procedures, troubleshoot data issues, and optimize query performance.

questions.label: On a scale of 1–5, how would you rate your proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including data modeling, Power Query, DAX, creating measures and calculated columns, developing dashboards, and optimizing report performance?
options: 1 - Beginner – Limited Power BI experience; can navigate existing reports but needs guidance to create or modify visualizations.
2 - Basic – Can create simple reports and dashboards using existing datasets, basic visualizations, and filters.
3 - Intermediate – Can independently build reports and dashboards, use Power Query for data transformations, and create basic DAX measures and data models.
4 - Advanced – Can develop complex data models, write DAX measures and calculated columns, use Power Query, troubleshoot data issues, and optimize report performance.
5 - Expert – Extensive Power BI expertise, including advanced DAX, complex semantic models, performance optimization, row-level security, and scalable reporting solutions.

questions.label: On a scale of 1–5, how would you rate your hands-on experience with AWS QuickSight or other AWS data analytics services, particularly in developing dashboards, connecting to data sources, and creating reports?
options: 1 - No Experience – No hands-on experience with AWS QuickSight or AWS data analytics services.
2 - Basic – Have viewed or made minor edits to existing QuickSight dashboards or reports, with limited development experience.
3 - Intermediate – Can independently create dashboards and visualizations, connect to data sources, and build reports in QuickSight.
4 - Advanced – Can develop sophisticated dashboards, work with multiple data sources, troubleshoot data issues, and optimize reporting solutions.
5 - Expert – Extensive experience designing and maintaining scalable analytics solutions using QuickSight and AWS data services, including complex data integrations and performance optimization.
